CalcChunkRef.description: A field or custom function FileMaker itself resolved inside a calculation (a ChunkList token).
CalcChunkRef.title: CalcChunkRef

ContractSource.description: The FileMaker file the docs describe. Never a path on the machine that built them.
ContractSource.title: ContractSource

CustomMenuItem.description: Embedded within CustomMenuEntity — not a standalone entity.
CustomMenuItem.title: CustomMenuItem

DataSourcePairingInfo.description: Which file of a batch build a data source was paired with (batch/links.py), or why none.
DataSourcePairingInfo.title: DataSourcePairingInfo

EntityCalculation.description: A calculation an entity owns: a field's formula, a layout object's hide condition, ...
EntityCalculation.title: EntityCalculation

ExternalDataSource.description: An entry of the file's External Data Sources catalog (other files it reaches into).
ExternalDataSource.title: ExternalDataSource

ExternalTarget.description:
Everything known about a reference that points into another file.

Captured so a later multi-file run can resolve it against the sister
file's export: match ``uuid`` first, then ``fmp_id``, then ``name``
(for fields: ``base_table`` + ``name``). ``data_source`` is the *name of
the external data source* in this file, which is a label, not necessarily
the target file's name — see ``DocumentModel.external_data_sources``.
ExternalTarget.title: ExternalTarget

FileOptions.description: File > File Options: what runs and opens when the file does.
FileOptions.title: FileOptions

Generator.description: What wrote the file. ``None`` on a file upgraded from before the contract existed.
Generator.title: Generator

GraphNote.description: A text note on the relationship graph, and the table occurrences it lies over.
GraphNote.title: GraphNote

GraphRect.description: A rectangle on the relationship graph (or a layout), in points.
GraphRect.title: GraphRect

IndirectCandidate.description: An entity a site may name, and why we think so.
IndirectCandidate.title: IndirectCandidate

IndirectionSite.description: One place a name is consumed: a sink function's argument or a by-name step target.
IndirectionSite.title: IndirectionSite

LayoutObjectBounds.description: Bounds of a layout object on the layout, in points (the same numbers as FileMaker's clipboard).
LayoutObjectBounds.title: LayoutObjectBounds

LayoutObjectEntity.description:
A single object placed on a layout — a field, button, text block, portal, etc.

Layout objects are nested inside ``<Part><ObjectList>`` in the SaveAsXML
format. They carry the field placements that the layout displays, along
with text, buttons, and other on-layout content.
LayoutObjectEntity.title: LayoutObjectEntity

LayoutPart.description: A layout part (Header, Body, Sub-summary, ...), top to bottom.
LayoutPart.title: LayoutPart

LocalStyle.description:
``<LocalCSS type name displayName>`` on a layout object or part (the CSS itself isn't kept).

``ThemeCustomStyle``: a theme's named style (``name`` is its class, ``displayName`` what
FileMaker shows). ``ObjectCustomStyle``: local changes only, usually with no name.
LocalStyle.title: LocalStyle

ModificationInfo.description: Who last changed an item, and when (from the SaXML ``<UUID>`` stamp).
ModificationInfo.title: ModificationInfo

PortalOptions.description: A portal's setup: which rows it shows and in what order (its filter is in the object's calculations).
PortalOptions.title: PortalOptions

PrivilegeCategory.description: Records, Layouts, Value Lists or Scripts: a blanket setting, or a custom per-object list.
PrivilegeCategory.title: PrivilegeCategory

PrivilegeFieldAccess.description: One field of a table row whose field access is "Custom".
PrivilegeFieldAccess.title: PrivilegeFieldAccess

PrivilegeItem.description: One row of a custom privilege list: a table, layout, value list or script and its access.
PrivilegeItem.title: PrivilegeItem

RelationshipSide.description: Options about the records of one side's table occurrence.
RelationshipSide.title: RelationshipSide

ScriptTriggerInfo.description: A script trigger on a layout or layout object, e.g. OnLayoutEnter -> script.
ScriptTriggerInfo.title: ScriptTriggerInfo

SortField.description: One sort level: a field and its order. A custom order names the value list giving it.
SortField.title: SortField

SourceXmlInfo.description: Trace back to the originating XML location for debugging.
SourceXmlInfo.title: SourceXmlInfo

StepCalculation.description: One calculated parameter of a script step, e.g. Set Variable's value or repetition.
StepCalculation.title: StepCalculation

VariableEntity.description:
A ``$$global`` (file-wide) or a ``$local`` (one script) variable.

FileMaker variable names are case-insensitive; ``name`` keeps the first spelling seen.
VariableEntity.title: VariableEntity

VariableUse.description: One place a variable is assigned or read.
VariableUse.title: VariableUse
